visibleInputs: data/replays/e09-qwen3-4b/<family>.json (the model's raw JSON per thread, recorded once from the local Ollama; replayed, hash-checked on model + prompt + schema)
hypothesis: A local schema-constrained model (qwen3:4b, four few-shot examples, evidence-substring validator) recovers claims the rules extractor misses on the E01 families, and the union commit (rules first, model-only claims labelled with the model's route) raises claim recall without lowering precision or merging cases falsely.

variants.description: The real import path with the rules extractor (as E01 variant a)
qwen3:4b proposals after the validator, scored directly without memory/commit (as E01 variant b)
the same proposals alone through the real commitProposal in an evidence-only store (as E01 variant c)
what POST /import commits with extract=local: the rules commit, then enrichWithModel commits the model proposal re-keyed to the rules incidents (memory/enrich.ts)

config.prompt: memory/extractor-llm.ts buildExtractionPrompt (four few-shot examples, indexed messages with evidence and actor ids); Ollama format = the zod schema as JSON schema; think:false, temperature 0, seed 7
config.validator: validateExtraction: drop any claim/entity/link citing an unknown message or an excerpt not in the message text (whitespace-tolerant); links to unknown people dropped
config.claimMatch: same ClaimType and token Jaccard >= 0.5 (benchmarks/evaluator.ts), as E01
config.budget: the live extract slot has one 60 s deadline per import; the experiment lifts it (600 s per call) so the model output is scored, and reports the recorded latencies against the 60 s budget
config.briefModel: qwen3:4b is the brief's extract model; when it is not installed the runner records with the installed model named here (D-B2-40)

acceptanceCriteria: Report all four arms side by side per split; no winner is declared (as E01).
The rules extractor remains the default extract route regardless of the result; extract=local stays opt-in.
List the truth claims the model recovered and the rules missed, and every item the validator dropped.
stopRule: One recording pass per family; replay thereafter. A fallback or a missing recording in replay mode fails the run.
